themes.label: Bank closed my account without explanation
themes.question: Why did the bank close my account, and what happens to my money?
themes.gap: The only closure content is about closures the customer starts. Nothing explains why the bank might close or restrict an account, what notice to expect, or what happens to the money.
subissues: Closing an account — Company closed your account
Closing your account — Company closed your account

themes.label: Deposit held, missing, or reversed
themes.question: My deposit is on hold, missing, or was reversed. When can I use my money?
themes.gap: Explains why holds happen and how you're notified. Nothing on deposits that go missing, are reversed after funds were released, or on cashing a check.
subissues: Managing an account — Deposits and withdrawals
Managing an account — Cashing a check
Managing an account — Deposits or withdrawals

themes.label: Card dispute denied, stuck, or reversed
themes.question: I disputed a charge and the bank denied it, reversed my credit, or it's taking forever. What are my options?
themes.gap: Covers how to file and where to track status. No expected timeline, and nothing on what happens if the dispute is denied or the temporary credit is reversed, or how to appeal.
subissues: Problem with a purchase shown on your statement — Credit card company isn't resolving a dispute about a purchase on your statement
Problem with a purchase shown on your statement — Overcharged for something you did purchase with the card
Problem with a company's investigation into an existing problem — Problem with personal statement of dispute

themes.label: Collections calls, threats, and credit-damage warnings
themes.question: Collections keeps calling or threatening to hurt my credit. What are my rights?
themes.gap: No content on Bank of America's own collections or recovery process, charge-offs, how collections contacts work, or how accounts are reported while in collections.
subissues: Took or threatened to take negative or legal action — Threatened or suggested your credit would be damaged
Took or threatened to take negative or legal action — Seized or attempted to seize your property
Communication tactics — Frequent or repeated calls

themes.label: Charges or withdrawals I didn't make
themes.question: There's a charge or withdrawal on my account that I didn't make. What happens now?
themes.gap: Covers reporting and next-day credit for credit-card fraud. For debit, ACH, and checking fraud: no claim timeline and no explanation of what happens if the claim is denied.
subissues: Problem with a lender or other company charging your account — Transaction was not authorized
Problem with a purchase shown on your statement — Card was charged for something you did not purchase with the card

themes.label: Collections on a debt I don't owe or can't verify
themes.question: I'm being collected on for a debt that isn't mine, is already paid, or is the wrong amount.
themes.gap: Nothing on disputing or verifying a debt the bank is collecting, or on a debt that was already paid.
subissues: Attempts to collect debt not owed — Debt is not yours
False statements or representation — Attempted to collect wrong amount
Written notification about debt — Didn't receive enough information to verify debt

themes.label: Debit card or ATM problem
themes.question: My debit card was declined / the ATM didn't give me cash / I need to dispute a debit transaction.
themes.gap: Covers how to dispute a debit transaction, PIN problems, and card replacement. Nothing on an ATM that didn't dispense cash or credit a deposit, or on why a debit card is declined.
subissues: Managing an account — Problem using a debit or ATM card

themes.label: Transfer or payment not handled as instructed / bank error
themes.question: I made a payment or transfer and the bank didn't handle it the way I asked (or made an error).
themes.gap: Explains transfer mechanics and cutoff times. Nothing on how to report a bank error or payment that didn't go as instructed, or how long a correction takes.
subissues: Managing an account — Funds not handled or disbursed as instructed
Managing an account — Banking errors
Managing an account — Problem making or receiving payments

themes.label: Can't open an account / didn't get the advertised terms
themes.question: Why can't I open an account, and where's the bonus or terms I was promised?
themes.gap: Nothing on why an application might be declined or need extra verification, or on promised bonuses that weren't paid.
subissues: Opening an account — Unable to open an account
Opening an account — Didn't receive terms that were advertised
Opening an account — Confusing or missing disclosures

themes.label: Zelle / P2P scam or fraud
themes.question: I was scammed (or my account was used) through Zelle. Can I get my money back?
themes.gap: One sentence says that qualifying imposter scams "may be eligible for reimbursement". It doesn't say who qualifies, how to file, how long it takes, or what happens with other kinds of scams.
subissues: Fraud or scam
products: Money transfer, virtual currency, or money service

themes.label: Can't get my money back from a closed account
themes.question: My account was closed. When and how do I get my remaining balance?
themes.gap: Closure content tells customers to move their balance out before closing. Nothing says how or when the remaining money is returned after the bank closes the account.
subissues: Closing an account — Funds not received from closed account

themes.label: Account or card opened in my name (identity theft)
themes.question: Someone opened an account or card in my name. How do I report it and clean it up?
themes.gap: Only generic 'freeze your credit, call us' guidance. No Bank of America process for an account or card opened in your name, or for clearing it from your credit report.
subissues: Getting a credit card — Card opened without my consent or knowledge
Opening an account — Account opened without my consent or knowledge
Attempts to collect debt not owed — Debt was result of identity theft

themes.label: Credit card payment problems
themes.question: My card payment didn't post, was applied wrong, or I never got a bill.
themes.gap: Covers payment methods and how to avoid late fees. Nothing on a payment that didn't post or was applied wrong, or on a statement that never arrived.
subissues: Problem when making payments — Problem during payment process
Problem when making payments — You never received your bill or did not know a payment was due

themes.label: Wrong information on my credit report
themes.question: The bank is reporting something wrong to the credit bureaus. How do I get it fixed?
themes.gap: Sends customers to the credit bureaus, with phone numbers for contacting the bank. No direct process or timeline for disputing what the bank reported.
subissues: Incorrect information on your report — Account status incorrect
Problem with a company's investigation into an existing problem — Their investigation did not fix an error on your report
Incorrect information on your report — Account information incorrect

themes.label: Can't stop a recurring charge, or wrong-day / wrong-amount withdrawal
themes.question: How do I stop a merchant or company from taking money out of my account?
themes.gap: Stop-payment content covers paper checks only. Nothing on stopping a recurring debit or ACH withdrawal from a merchant, or on revoking authorization.
subissues: Problem with a lender or other company charging your account — Money was taken from your account on the wrong day or for the wrong amount
Problem with a lender or other company charging your account — Can't stop withdrawals from your account

themes.label: Rewards, promo, or balance-transfer terms not honored
themes.question: I didn't get the rewards, promo rate, or balance-transfer terms I was promised.
themes.gap: Covers redeeming rewards and how payments apply to promo balances. Nothing on rewards, bonuses, or promo rates that were never credited.
subissues: Other features, terms, or problems — Problem with rewards from credit card
Advertising and marketing, including promotional offers — Didn't receive advertised or promotional terms
Other features, terms, or problems — Problem with balance transfer

themes.label: Card application, credit limit, or card won't work
themes.question: My application was denied or delayed, my limit changed, or my card won't work.
themes.gap: Covers application status and credit-line increases. Nothing on why an application was denied or a limit was lowered.
subissues: Trouble using your card — Can't use card to make purchases
Getting a credit card — Application denied
Trouble using your card — Credit card company won't increase or decrease your credit limit

themes.label: Locked out, frozen, or can't access my account
themes.question: My account is locked, frozen, or restricted. How do I get back in?
themes.gap: Covers forgotten user IDs and passwords. Nothing on accounts the bank has locked, frozen, or restricted, or on how to verify your identity to get back in.
subissues: Managing an account — Problem accessing account

themes.label: Struggling to pay / need a payment plan
themes.question: I can't make my payments. What hardship or payment-plan options do I have?
themes.gap: Says 'call us to explore options' and links to credit counseling. It doesn't describe any actual hardship or payment-plan options.
subissues: Struggling to pay your bill — Credit card company won't work with you while you're going through financial hardship
Struggling to pay your bill — Problem lowering your monthly payments
Struggling to pay your bill — Filed for bankruptcy

themes.label: Transfer didn't arrive, wrong amount, or can't be traced
themes.question: My transfer / Zelle / wire didn't arrive or went to the wrong place. Where is my money?
themes.gap: Zelle pending, failed, and not-received scenarios are answered in detail. Wire tracing is thin.
subissues: Other transaction problem
Money was not available when promised
Unauthorized transactions or other transaction problem
products: Money transfer, virtual currency, or money service

themes.label: Overdraft, NSF, and account fees
themes.question: Why was I charged an overdraft or account fee, and can it be refunded?
themes.gap: Well covered, including a worked example. But the page's structured data (what search engines and AI assistants read) still shows a $35 fee in the example, while the visible page shows $10.

Problem caused by your funds being low — Non-sufficient funds and associated fees
Managing an account — Fee problem

themes.label: Other / customer-service problems
themes.question: Other issues and poor customer-service experiences.
themes.gap: Catch-all bucket, not scored.
subissues: Other features, terms, or problems — Other problem
Other features, terms, or problems — Problem with customer service
Closing an account — Fees charged for closing account

themes.label: Credit card fees and interest
themes.question: Why was I charged this fee or interest on my credit card?
themes.gap: A 24-question fees FAQ explains each fee and how to avoid it. Nothing on getting a fee refunded.
subissues: Fees or interest — Problem with fees
Fees or interest — Charged too much interest
Fees or interest — Unexpected increase in interest rate

themes.label: Can't close my account
themes.question: How do I close my account, and why won't it close?
themes.gap: Step-by-step closure instructions by phone, mail, online, and in branch.
